coordinateSpace: Normalized activeDish coordinates, before dishRoot transform
method: Exact unsampled convex hull of all indexed drawable decoded vertices, including all node transforms. No QJ jitter, simplification, or coordinate rounding.

provenance.rightsScope: Derived geometric metadata only. Original author, attribution and licence are not changed or expanded. Existing user-authorized Vistaire runtime and supplied model assets; no broader redistribution licence is inferred.

presentation: Base-normalized coordinates at maxDimension=2.35. Apply the live dishRoot world transform and the model presentation scale (burger=0.55, others=1); do not apply activeDish normalization again.
